name: The Final Stew
source:
Irone was cooked as Ambia's food, leaving the world of the living. Now, as a ghost, Irone watches Ambia prepare one last meal from Irone's body.

[From [url=https://norbez.itch.io/the-final-stew]Itch.io[/url]]
